name: chatmem
description: Local LLM chat history served over MCP. Captures conversations from any MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, aider) into an embedded Postgres 18 + pgvector database on the user's own machine, then serves relevant snippets back via search_history. Message content never leaves the machine — only anonymous usage counters do, and those can be disabled.

installation.brew: brew tap sid077/chatmem && brew install --cask chatmem
installation.zypper: sudo zypper ar https://sid077.github.io/chatmem/chatmem.repo && sudo zypper in chatmem
installation.dnf: sudo dnf config-manager --add-repo https://sid077.github.io/chatmem/chatmem.repo && sudo dnf install chatmem

tools.name: record_message
tools.description: Store a single chat message in the local chatmem database. Opens a new conversation when conversation_id is empty; model/provider/client_id are then required.

conversation_id.description: UUID of existing conversation; omit to open a new one

model.description: model id, e.g. claude-opus-4-7 (required when opening a new conversation)

provider.description: provider, e.g. anthropic (required when opening a new conversation)

client_id.description: client id, e.g. claude-code, cursor, windsurf, aider (required when opening a new conversation)

token_count.description: optional token count for the message

tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Search stored chat history for messages relevant to a query. Returns snippets packed to a token budget, one per conversation. MVP uses Postgres full-text ranking; semantic re-ranking via embeddings ships next.

client_id.description: filter by client id (e.g. claude-code, cursor)

since.description: RFC3339 lower bound on message creation time

until.description: RFC3339 upper bound on message creation time

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Fetch a conversation and its messages, ordered by creation time. Cursor-paginated via the after timestamp.

after.description: RFC3339 timestamp cursor; return messages strictly after this
